$comment: Reference operators LITIX benchmarks a channel against.
This file is a starting point, not a fixed truth. Handles change and channels drift;
edit it freely and point LITIX at your own copy with --references <path>.
Any handle that fails to resolve is skipped with a warning rather than failing the run.
'mechanic' is the specific, transferable thing the account proves — that is what gets benchmarked,

creators.name: Southeast Softwash
creators.mechanic: Documents real jobs and real pricing, then sells the systems and chemicals behind them to the people who want the same business.

creators.name: Alex Hormozi
creators.mechanic: Gives away the complete tactical playbook for free and monetizes the tier above it — capital, not courses.
